description: Seed a fresh (greenfield) repository with the PRD-Driven Context Engineering scaffold — PRD.md, SoT/ knowledge files, EPIC templates, domain-profile config, and agent MEMORY starters. Invoked as /prd-ce:init when the plugin is installed. The framework itself (skills, agents, hooks, scripts) ships LIVE in the plugin; this skill only plants the consumer-owned files the plugin cannot carry as behavior. Triggers on "/prd-ce:init", "set up PRD lifecycle here", "scaffold a new PRD-CE project", "initialize the methodology". Outputs a seeded scaffold + a verification report.
